notes: GEM solar/wind rows are filtered to projects >= 100 MW and non-cancelled statuses.
Hydropower rows are filtered to stations >= 100 MW.
PV footprint summaries are written to public\data\china-pv\solar-footprints-summary.json and are never converted to installed MW.
Downloaded OSM PBF is processed by scripts/build-china-osm-power-data.py into local GeoJSON and vector tiles for OSM power infrastructure.
PeeringDB facilities with coordinates are rendered without inferred MW load; missing-coordinate facilities are written to docs\research\opengridworks\peeringdb-cn-manual-review.csv.
Official NEA/NBS validation outputs are written to public\data\china-validation and are not GIS sources.
Supplemental coastal risk metadata is written to public\data\china-validation\coastal-risk-candidate.json and is not rendered by default.
